mapper.insert: insert into events (event_nm, open_dt, total_quota, issued_count, valid_from, valid_to, status) values (#{eventNm}, #{openDt}, #{totalQuota}, #{issuedCount}, #{validFrom}, #{validTo}, #{status})
mapper.select: select * from events where status = #{status} order by open_dt
mapper.update: update events set event_nm = #{eventNm}, open_dt = #{openDt}, total_quota = #{totalQuota}, issued_count = #{issuedCount}, valid_from = #{validFrom}, valid_to = #{validTo}, status = #{status}, close_reason = #{closeReason}, closed_at = #{closedAt}, updated_at = now() where id = #{id}
